notes: Active-context thresholds >1e-8 are numerical diagnostics, not behavior labels.
Participation maxima include acquisition and disposable probes; not simultaneous whole-brain motor activity.
Generic added KCs are analytically silent because .05 maximum incoming drive <.15 threshold; class-consistent added-KC counts are measured.
Stage3 comparison metric is resource contrast, while freeze primarily tests experience; acute modulation can remain.
